title: Fapland Remastered
description:
# Fapland Remastered

1.0 Changelog [18.4GB]

Combined parts 1+2 posted on /h/ and combined+seeded for your enjoyment. If you already have part 1, just download the movies you don't have.

NO NEED TO INSTALL. Just run as is.

NEW FEATURES
- All videos now play in-game
- Certain items now work in-game
- System to track how many rounds have been beaten
- 6 additional rounds including final round after beating 51 rounds
- Player can only save at checkpoints
- Overworld beat mechanic with music
- Credits after beating the game (please check CREDITS.txt in game files to see full credits)

NEW ITEMS
- All items are removed when unequipped or consumed

- Gold Pendant - Allows for 10 second break outside of rounds. Recharges at each checkpoint. [Added Notification and recharge mechanic]
- Imoutos Heart/Onee-sans Soul - Allows items to not get destroyed on unequip [Added full functionality and notification]
- Silver Bell - Allows player to see round difficulty when equipped [Added full functionality]
- Sex Techniques - Allows player to skip a round [Added full functionality]
- Underworld Headphones - Allows player to ignore overworld beats when equipped
- Monster's Blanket - Allows player to take 10 seconds break each round when equipped
- Phoenix Feather - Allows player to save and resume from anywhere [Added full functionality]

NEW LOCATIONS
- Tower Room
- Bonus Challenge Room

MISC
- Revamped conversations for most characters
- Swapped characters in Cum Lair and Kink Dungeon
- Added 'moving to new location' sound effects
- Added icons for locations on overworld map
- Updated look of various locations
- Added custom title screen
- Changed controls (check CONTROLS.txt)
